purpose: Filler: Zero's loop (lab/zero/loop.mjs) plays the latest nets zl21 against themselves; games for the next generation. The quick recipe (Korbi 18 Nov 12:21 local test, 21:21 crown): 256 deals on every move, the close-call look one turn, 9,600 games a generation (8 a shard); resigning after the confirming deep search; 1 game in 10 against the previous nets and 1 in 20 against g12r-C, both sides full, played out. Decision lines carry the search's replies to every cast (`r`). From zps024 (19 Nov 2026, Korbi "do both", sized by Fable): prior=1, the policy as the search's prior on near-ties, k = 1 x the standard error of the top-two gap; priorsplit: on even shards only, so the batch reads with and without it; vsresign=0.2: a fifth of the rival games resign for real (the goal's engine). From 19 Nov 21:52Z (Korbi: more zl against zl, none against live Monte): 1 game in 5 against the previous nets, none against g12r-C. From 20 Nov 2026 ~08:40Z (Korbi 10:28 local): no game resigns (resign keep 1: the would-resign point is still noted) and no decided-game shortcut, as g12r-C's training games; rival games never resign either (vsresign off).
